Table 2: Main results on three benchmarks.

Method            Memory     Planning    Tool Use
Baseline          61.2       55.4        48.9
ReAct             68.5       60.1        57.3
Ours (full)       74.8       66.9        63.5
Ours - search     71.0       62.4        58.1

As shown above, the proposed method improves over the strongest
baseline by a clear margin across all three benchmark families
considered in this study, which is consistent with the ablation
results reported in the previous section of this paper.
